fields.System.Title: Fix TerminationDrawing update deletes wrong shapes at LOC-1
fields.System.Description:
When the UpdateDrawing method runs it removes cable shapes and terminal arrangement markers using plain IDs instead of the composite key stored in insertedTags, so LOC-1 equipment placed by TerminationDrawingInserter disappears from the canvas.

The EquipmentInserter composite key system should be used to distinguish LOC-0 from LOC-1 cable and terminal arrangement shapes. The insertedTags lookup must use the full composite key including the ConnectivitySide metadata.
